title: A Visit to the Doctor
sentences: Anna did not feel well last week.
She had a headache and felt very tired.
She decided to see a doctor near her home.
The doctor checked her and asked some questions.
He said she needed more sleep and less stress.
Anna promised to go to bed earlier every night.
She also started to walk every morning before work.
Now she feels much better and has more energy.
She drinks more water and eats more vegetables too.
Her friends say she looks healthier and happier now.
